единицы.утверждение_en: Nano Banana Pro (Gemini 3 Pro image) is a sophisticated reasoning-driven engine for professional-grade image editing and generation, offering studio-quality precision and advanced creative control.
единицы.цитата:
is a sophisticated reasoning-driven engine for
professional-grade image editing and generation, offering studio-quality
precision and advanced creative control.
единицы.заметка: Подлежащее 'Nano Banana Pro' — на строке 190 txt. Цитата с переносами строк как в txt (строки 191-193). 'reasoning-driven' согласуется с Thinking: Supported в таблице.

единицы.утверждение_en: Nano Banana Pro is best for complex graphic design, high-fidelity product mockups, and factual data visualizations that require accurate text rendering and real-world grounding via Google Search.
единицы.цитата:
Nano Banana Pro is best for complex
graphic design, high-fidelity product mockups, and factual data visualizations
that require accurate text rendering and real-world grounding via Google Search.
единицы.заметка: Правило выбора модели: сложная графика, мокапы продуктов, фактические инфографики/визуализации данных, где нужен точный текст в кадре и опора на Google Search. Цитата с переносами строк (строки 193-195).

единицы.утверждение_en: Nano Banana Pro (gemini-3-pro-image) can be tried in Google AI Studio.

page for full

единицы.утверждение_en: Image generation is supported by gemini-3-pro-image.
The Live API is not supported by gemini-3-pro-image.
Search grounding (Grounding with Google Search) is supported by gemini-3-pro-image.
Structured outputs are not supported by gemini-3-pro-image.
Thinking is supported by gemini-3-pro-image.
URL context is not supported by gemini-3-pro-image.
gemini-3-pro-image can be used through the Batch API.
Flex inference is not supported for gemini-3-pro-image.
Priority inference is not supported for gemini-3-pro-image.
gemini-3-pro-image is offered as a stable version under the model code gemini-3-pro-image.

длинная_дистанция.заметка: Сводка таблицы: из 12 строк Supported только Image generation, Search grounding, Thinking.
